analyzers.title: ELF
analyzers.description: Parses ELF headers, sections, dynamic libraries, symbols and hardening flags.

analyzers.title: PE
analyzers.description: Parses PE headers, sections, imports, the import hash (imphash), DLL characteristics and Authenticode presence.

analyzers.title: Mach-O
analyzers.description: Parses Mach-O load commands, segments, linked dylibs and code signature presence. Reads the fat header too.

analyzers.title: WebAssembly
analyzers.description: Parses WASM sections, imports and exports, and notes the custom name and producers sections.

analyzers.title: Go and Rust build info
analyzers.description: Reads embedded Go build info and cargo-auditable dependency data from native binaries.

analyzers.title: Entropy and packers
analyzers.description: Builds an entropy map of the file and looks for packers, protectors and JavaScript obfuscators.

analyzers.title: Strings
analyzers.description: Extracts printable ASCII and UTF-16 strings and tags the interesting ones (urls, ips, paths, commands).

analyzers.title: Archives and packages
analyzers.description: Lists ZIP, JAR, APK, CRX, XPI, VSIX, npm tarball, gzip, tar and Electron ASAR members and analyzes the important ones recursively.

analyzers.title: Extension and package audit
analyzers.description: Audits browser extensions (CRX, XPI), VS Code extensions (VSIX) and npm tarballs for risky permissions, remote code and install scripts.

analyzers.title: Bundle SBOM
analyzers.description: Finds npm packages and versions inside minified JavaScript bundles and package.json files, with purl ids for CycloneDX.

analyzers.title: Source maps
analyzers.description: Detects source map references and inline maps, and reports how much original source can be rebuilt from sourcesContent.

analyzers.title: Secrets
analyzers.description: Finds hardcoded credentials: cloud keys, tokens, private keys and high entropy secret assignments. Values are redacted in the report.

analyzers.title: Attack surface
analyzers.description: Maps network endpoints, API paths, GraphQL operations, Electron IPC channels, feature flags and storage keys.

analyzers.title: Capabilities
analyzers.description: Maps imports and strings to capabilities and MITRE ATT&CK techniques, in the spirit of Mandiant capa.

analyzers.title: Rules (yara-lite)
analyzers.description: Runs the built in rule pack plus your own YARA style rules, in pure TypeScript.

analyzers.title: Android APK
analyzers.description: Decodes the binary manifest, APK signatures, DEX code, native libraries and app frameworks, and reports exported components, risky flags, sensitive API calls and hardcoded secrets.

analyzers.title: Android DEX
analyzers.description: Parses DEX files: classes, methods, strings, libraries, obfuscation, sensitive API calls, URLs and keys.

analyzers.title: Java class file
analyzers.description: Parses Java .class files: version, declaration, fields and methods.

analyzers.title: iOS IPA
analyzers.description: Reads Info.plist, URL schemes, ATS, entitlements, embedded frameworks, extensions and the app framework of an IPA.

analyzers.title: Unity IL2CPP metadata
analyzers.description: Reads global-metadata.dat: version, images, type, method and string literal counts.

analyzers.title: .NET assembly
analyzers.description: Reads ECMA-335 metadata: assembly identity, target framework, references, P/Invoke, resources, ReadyToRun, single-file bundles and obfuscator markers.

analyzers.title: Python bytecode and freezers
analyzers.description: Parses .pyc headers and code objects, lists PyInstaller archives, and spots Nuitka, py2exe and cx_Freeze builds.

analyzers.title: Lua bytecode
analyzers.description: Lists Lua 5.1 to 5.4 and LuaJIT bytecode: header, functions, constants.

analyzers.title: Erlang BEAM
analyzers.description: Lists BEAM chunks, atoms, exports and imports of Erlang and Elixir modules.

analyzers.title: EVM bytecode
analyzers.description: Disassembles Ethereum bytecode, extracts function selectors, proxy patterns and Solidity metadata.

analyzers.title: JavaScript endpoints, bundles and obfuscation

analyzers.title: Source map recovery

analyzers.title: Electron app audit

analyzers.title: SQLite database
